results.title: Skill authoring best practices - Claude API Docs
results.content: File paths matter: Claude navigates your skill directory like a filesystem. Use forward slashes (reference/guide.md), not backslashes · Name files descriptively: Use names that indicate content: form_validation_rules.md, not doc2.md · Organize for discovery: Structure directories by domain or feature
